[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-52[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Links go to the reading queue: URL routing for bob capture, Bob Mac[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Capture, and bob gkeep pull[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]A bare public link lands in Bob's reading queue instead of becoming[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]an inbox task. This covers a link captured with `bob capture` or [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Bob Mac Capture, whether alone, in a pasted list, or mixed with [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]ordinary tasks, and a link shared to Google Keep and pulled with [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`bob gkeep pull`. Every path uses the same ingest engine as `bob [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]ref create`. Capture stays instant, works offline, and never loses [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]a link. The preview says honestly, without touching the network, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]whether the link is new or already in the library. Submit queues a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]durable ref job, and a detached background worker clips it. If a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]clip fails, the link falls back to exactly today's inbox task, plus[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]a ⚠️ reason and a retry command. Keep pull clips inline and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]archives a note only after a terminal outcome. Bob Mac Capture [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]presents the new reference item beautifully and parses nothing [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]itself. Every path has an opt-out.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]9[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202610/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]url_capture_ref_routing.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202610/url_capture_ref_routing.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]bob-cli-52[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-cli--beads/blob/main/pages/bob-cli-52/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Typed, non-printing URL ingest extracted from bob ref create[/bold #D7AFFF]  [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]ingest[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]ingest: extract a typed URL ingest API from `ref create`. It returns [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]created, already-in-library, and already-queued outcomes, or a typed [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]error kind with a retryable flag. It uses fixed reading-queue defaults, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]a machine-wide ingest lock, and fsync on install. `ref create` output [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and exit codes stay byte-identical. Also add the shared ⚠️ fallback-note[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]helper.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]uv resolution, URL safety, and doctor rows[/bold #D7AFFF]                    [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]hardening[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]hardening: one shared `resolve_uv()` for the clip adapter, the Keep [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]adapter, and gkeep doctor, with uv rows in both doctors. Also the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]bob-cli-4v IPv4-mapped IPv6 fix, a resolved-address check that pins [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]every curl hop, and the `--max-time` doc drift fix.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]URL-intent classifier, routing policy, and offline library [/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
      [bold #D7AFFF]verdict[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]intent[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]intent: a new `url_routing` module with the strict bare-URL classifier, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]display formatting, the `highlights.url_routing` config policy [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF](per-entry-point toggles and `exclude_hosts`), an offline library [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]verdict that agrees exactly with create's dedupe, and a doctor routing [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]row.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Capture grammar for reference items and URL lists[/bold #D7AFFF]             [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]grammar[dim] · [dim][/dim]after intent[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]grammar: the whole-item bare-URL claim and `CaptureKind::Ref`, the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]lexical URL-list split in shared draft splitting, the editor `ref` mode [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and `ref_url` span, and routing-option plumbing. Every production caller[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]keeps routing off until phase capture.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Ref job spool, background worker, and bob ref jobs[/bold #D7AFFF]            [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]jobs[dim] · [dim][/dim]after ingest, intent[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]jobs: the durable job spool under the bob-cli state directory; a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]single-flight worker that is crash-safe and has no lost wakeups; its [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]fully detached kick; the lossless inbox-task fallback writer; `bob ref [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]jobs` (bare = list) and `bob ref jobs run`; doctor rows; and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`docs/ref-jobs.md`.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]bob gkeep pull clips URL-only Keep notes[/bold #D7AFFF]                      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]gkeep[dim] · [dim][/dim]after ingest, hardening, intent[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]gkeep: the adapter emits shared-link annotations; the R5 URL-only rule [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]becomes a `create_ref` plan action; a clip pre-pass runs before the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]vault lock; a `ref_created` journal event; retryable failures stay in [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Keep and permanent ones are written as tasks with a ⚠️ note; the archive[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]guard checks attachment counts. Also covers dry-run, list, JSON, `-R`, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and docs.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]bob capture queues bare links for the reading queue[/bold #D7AFFF]           [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]capture[dim] · [dim][/dim]after grammar, jobs[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]capture: turn routing on in `capture` and `capture-parse`. Plan [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]reference items with the offline verdict (including clipping and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]duplicate links), emit the additive JSON and the human wording, enqueue [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]job files as rolled-back staged side effects, kick the worker after [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]commit, add `-R/--no-ref`, and write the docs.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  8 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Bob Mac Capture presents reference items[/bold #D7AFFF]                      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]mac[dim] · [dim][/dim]after capture[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]mac: in the linked bob-mac-capture repo, tolerantly decode the `ref` [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]object; add a reference card, status text, notification, and a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]link-colored `ref_url` span; open only targets that really exist; add [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`~/.local/bin` to PATH; and add fixtures recorded from real bob output, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]tests, README, and green macOS CI.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  9 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Live verification, install, and follow-ups[/bold #D7AFFF]                    [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]verify[dim] · [dim][/dim]after hardening, gkeep, capture, mac[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]verify: on athena, run the live article, PDF, arXiv, blocked, corporate [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]link, list, duplicate, and already-in-library exercises against a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]scratch vault; time a read-only dry run on the real vault; install; run [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]read-only Mac probes or write Bryan's Mac checklist; and record [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]follow-ups.[/#D7D7AF]
